label: Hidden Turn-Up Placket with Knots
description: The Hidden Turnup Placket with Knots is an elaborate bespoke construction in which the hidden placket is finished with hand-worked fabric knots at each button position, visible when the flap is opened. These twisted or knotted button loops are a signature detail of Neapolitan handmade shirtmaking — they replace standard buttons with soft fabric toggles and represent the highest tier of shirt craftsmanship. The effect is discreet from outside but reveals extraordinary hand-finishing when inspected closely.
